propositions: Explicit review-plan on a bug with non-test file_impact escalates from light advisory tier to full blocking rubric at both precheck and route_criteria enforcement seams, without CLI flags or schema changes.
Gerrit DET criterion blocks bug-fix commits with >150 non-test lines lacking a certified or code-drifted-acceptable plan-review attestation, reading cross-host via opcert verification machinery.

Plan-review attestation verification requires cross-host opcert validation (opcert_from_record + trusted_env_keyring keyed by record principal + verify_opcert + compute_validity) with ACCEPTED={certified, stale-code, stale-head} and INFRA-FAIL-OPEN on unavailable/error/unknown verdicts.
Non-test line classification excludes tests/** and conftest.py; threshold is a single shared constant (150 lines) used by both Gerrit criterion and backtest.
Backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits achieves exact set equality: flagged set matches the 13 hand-adjudicated substantive commits with zero mechanical false positives.
Claim-time bug exemption remains unchanged; blast radius is persisted in ticket state read by both enforcement steps and batch-runner fan-in.
